invariants.rationale: convertEngineSpecificDataToHoodieData always returns HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should not return null.
records is directly passed to HoodieListData.lazy(records), so a null input may cause an exception or is preconditioned to not occur.
HoodieListData.lazy(records) produces a HoodieData whose collectAsList returns the original records.
The number of elements in result matches the size of the input records.

invariants.expression: result.filter(ws -> ws == null).count() == records.stream().filter(ws -> ws == null).count()
invariants.rationale: Nullness of WriteStatus elements is preserved between records and result.
